lilscript.rawAndGzip: lilscript --config lilscript.objectives.toml --target js-module --mode production --cache off --jobs 1 (one compile writes both)

upstream.bundle: esbuild 0.28.1: bundle, esm, platform browser, conditions browser+production, external []

timing: Upstream lanes: bundling plus the minifier, one warm run. lil2: the whole compilation on one thread with caches off, from the build logs.
